What to bring

Skip a return trip. Have these ready before your visit.

Required documents
● Current driver's license (even if expired)
● Proof of residency dated within 90 days
● Social Security card or W-2 from the last 12 months
● Payment for the $36 renewal fee — card or check, no cash above $20
Helpful, not required
○ Eyeglasses or contacts if you wear them (we test vision on site)
○ Updated address or emergency contact
○ Organ donor preference (yes, no, or "ask me later")
○ A book. Honestly. Even on time, we run a little behind.
The fine print, briefly
SITUATION	WHAT WE DO	YOU
Reschedule, 24+ hours ahead	Free, no questions asked	—
Reschedule, under 24 hours	One-time courtesy; second time you'll wait 7 days	—
No show	Slot released, rebooking allowed after 48 hours	—
Missing documents on arrival	Check in deferred; you may be left with a queue same day	—
Office closed (weather, civic)	We move your slot to the next equivalent window	—
Accessibility & accommodations

All DTS offices are step-free, with assistive listening at every staffed counter and large-print forms available on request. Service animals welcome.
